notes:
Public primary spreadsheet locator returned 401 (sign-in required); used public primary report. Original accessible published/in-press version has analytic N=107, unlike report’s introductory 115. Original correlation uses participant change scores; replication uses repeated raw trial rows. Original page locator differs by manuscript version. For 339, extracted printed pairwise d rather than omnibus partial eta squared to match the two-condition contrast.
Completion source review (es_value_o): Paired-samples comparison of self-reported negative affect, reappraise negative versus look negative. Printed t = -11.78; same-test p < .001. The F(2, 212) = 297.20 test is a separate three-condition omnibus test.
